delta.description: Nine Chapters fangcheng interpretation: the counting-rod rectangular grid maps to the neutral carrier (positional meaning); the positive-negative method to signed arithmetic (正行/逆行, M0/M1/M2 marks, the i-j observer); 遍乘/直除 to elementary row operations (row scaling = normalization, row addition = the three declared repairs); row swap to the symbol-surface switch swap; elimination to ledger_check (forward elimination with predecessor pins as pivots); the receipt chain as an upper-triangular matrix whose reverse-trace is back-substitution. Pairs with al-Khwarizmi (entry 18): single unknown -> n unknowns, area -> grid, six forms -> one universal algorithm, and the matrix escapes the geometric dimension bound.

precise_correspondence.repairs: elementary row operations of type 3 (add a multiple of one row to another)
precise_correspondence.switch_swap: elementary row operation of type 2 (row exchange)

pair_with_entry_18.form: six standard types -> one universal algorithm
pair_with_entry_18.dimension: matrix escapes the geometric dimension bound

documented_holes: the user description says counting rods on an abacus (算盘); the standard account says rods on a counting board (算板) - flagged, not silently corrected
the mapping is interpretation, not isomorphism: no claim the receipt ledger 'is' a matrix, though it is checked matrix-wise
standard textbook account used; Guo Shuchun's collated edition not checked
no_claims: no claim the mapping licenses new native semantics in adva
interpretation only; the public library entry keeps pins and minimal quotes discipline
